label: Rigidity of concrete GOD_4 presence from the standpoint (de dicto to de re bridge)
term: concrete GOD_4 presence is rigid from the standpoint
definition: GodPresenceRigidAt σ m w: for every world v accessible from w and all x, y, if x is a concrete GOD_4 existing at w and y is a concrete GOD_4 existing at v, then y = x. It asserts no existence. It is anchored at w: it constrains only the comparison with GOD_4 concreta existing at w, so it is weaker than pairwise identity across all accessible worlds, and it says nothing about worlds inaccessible from w.
note: The explicit de dicto to de re bridge of the modal ontological route: with reflexivity at w it turns the de dicto box of GodConcreteExists into de re NecessaryAt of one individual (necessaryGod_of_box_rigid). Its positive warrant, if any, is classical theism's uniqueness of God applied across worlds together with rigid candidate identity; that warrant is not recorded here and the premise stays open. The controls show it is needed (swapped) and that the conclusion does not entail it (fixedPlusVisitor).
